description: This file defines the main application component for a React-based frontend. It includes a custom hook to detect viewport size and conditionally renders an overlay to restrict access to desktop devices only, delegating routing to AppRoutes when appropriate.

methods.name: useIsBelowDesktopBreakpoint
methods.description: Custom React hook that detects if the current viewport width is below a specified breakpoint (default 1024px), updating reactively on window resize.

methods.name: DesktopOnlyOverlay
methods.description: React functional component that displays an overlay message indicating the application is only accessible on desktop devices.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React component that conditionally renders either the DesktopOnlyOverlay or the AppRoutes component based on viewport size.
